metadata.article_title: Crediting sums realised by way of penalties to Consolidated Fund of India.

article.title: Crediting sums realised by way of penalties to Consolidated Fund of India.
article.content:
34Crediting sums realised by way of penalties to Consolidated Fund of India.

Section 34  ·  Chapter VIII  ·  page 20 of the Act
All sums realised by way of penalties imposed by the Board under this Act, shall be credited to the Consolidated Fund of India.
